impact_claims.description: Search 503 error rate reached 41% of requests at the peak of the incident.
Search p95 latency rose from ~220ms to ~900ms as the pool began to saturate.
The connection pool was fully saturated (active=20/20) with a wait queue up to 240 requests.
Degradation lasted roughly 45 minutes, from ~14:03 until recovery at 14:48.
